conventions.delta: Candidate minus baseline within the same block. Means add across solver phases. Paired medians and ranges describe spread.
conventions.gpu_host_setup: Spatial model and phase operator assembly or precontraction are in host setup. Galerkin has no separate measured precompute phase. FD176 dense precompute is measured separately.
conventions.gpu_runtime_init: CUDA context, module compile and load, library bindings and kernel registration are grouped. The switched runtime additionally loads the bridge module. No isolated JIT stopwatch was recorded.
conventions.gpu_graph_and_march: Both GPU arms use graph chunks of 24 and two priming FFT batches. The switched implementation captures two segments. March includes launch scheduling and final synchronization.
conventions.cpu_after_setup: Solver time after setup and before release of the returned model, including marching, observations and unseparated work. The fixed-rate operator contrast combines precontraction and mode-contiguous C/AVX2.
conventions.fresh_clock: Popen to flushed completion marker includes interpreter, imports and brief bookkeeping. NPZ serialization follows the acknowledgement. System and driver caches are retained.
conventions.monitor_labels: Count original above-threshold labels separately from entries that do not match a recorded cohort child PID. PID matching identifies a monitor label discrepancy without verifying all other process identities. Original monitoring records and isolation acceptance remain unchanged.
conventions.publication: External Python load was observed. Keep all five observations and use these contrasts as descriptive diagnostics of this cohort.
